newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse stops share rise of two more firms.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse stops share rise of two more firms.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) on Monday froze the share prices of Atok Big Wedge Co Inc and Itogon-Suyoc Mines Inc.
The PSE surveillance department said that Atok shares were frozen in late session after it reached 1.42 pesos a share, a 49.47 percent rise from 95 centavos.
Itogon Suyoc A shares were frozen at 6.25 centavos, a 45.35 percent increase from 4.3 centavos while its B shares were frozen at 6.5 centavos, a 47.73 percent increase from 4.4 centavos.
The share price of another company, Acoje Holdings Inc was also frozen after it reached 25 centavos or a 48.48 percent surge.
The Manila bourse freezes the share price of a company if it gains close to 50 percent or drops by 40 percent within a single session.

Atok shares have risen for the second straight day after market talk of a joint venture with Ayala Land Inc (ALI) surfaced. Ayala Land president Francisco Licuanan III said late Wednesday evening that the companies "have no financial relationship."
The PSE surveillance department said it has asked the three companies to explain the jump in prices.
